limitations_and_boundaries: CD-UCT is outperformed on average by the order-based CAM method on the SynTReN graphs.
NOTEARS may not return DAGs for some instances due to local optima.
GES and PC generally output large fractions of undirected edges.
The simulation policy treats each edge as equally likely during rollouts, which may result in noisy estimates of future rewards.
The method does not currently impose a limit on parent set sizes, which could improve scalability.
The method has not been evaluated on mixed discrete-continuous variables or non-decomposable score functions.
The method has not been adapted to search in ordering space or compared with ordering-based techniques.
The method has not been extended with neural networks for biasing search.
